docs.result: passed; final counters recorded by command output

visualInspection: Light/dark library, owned rows, subscriptions, grouped history, manager, mix and create/edit/delete/unsave forms; enlarged RTL, stale/partial failure, permission focus and new-upload feedback. Geometry checked in both engines at all three desktop widths; images inspected manually. Eight user-approved D1 originals unchanged.
limits: Watch/player/queue UI and embed visual migration retain D5/D7 owners; D4 verifies library-side occurrences and existing private/embed security.
Synthetic media, SSE and controlled network failures do not prove external upstream availability or native-app end-to-end behavior.
Mobile website deferred. Full linked builds and legacy retirement remain D8. No deployment.
